name: Reimagine Booking Integrator for TicketingHub
author: rtdev

sections.description:
Reimagine Booking Integrator for TicketingHub lets you embed any TicketingHub booking widget on any page or post using a simple shortcode.

This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with TicketingHub. We use TicketingHub on our own websites and have developed a complete Tour Engine theme with full TicketingHub integration.

How to Get Started

Getting started with Reimagine Booking Integrator for TicketingHub is simple. All you need is a free TicketingHub account and this plugin installed on your WordPress website.

  1. Install and activate the plugin on your WordPress site
  2. Go to Ticketing Hub in your WordPress admin menu to find your shortcode
  3. Add your booking widget to any page, post, or tour listing using the simple shortcode
  4. Bookings, availability, and payments are handled automatically through TicketingHub in real time

100% safe and secure — we only help you integrate your TicketingHub widgets. No additional setup or technical configuration required. Once installed, start selling tickets directly from your website immediately.

How to use

Place the shortcode anywhere on your site:

[reimtihu_widget_emb id="your-widget-id"]

Replace your-widget-id with the Widget ID from your TicketingHub account.

Example:

[reimtihu_widget_emb id="ba65706a-f794-468c-b8ba-c11c245b2010"]

Need More?

For popup booking widgets, tour management, multilingual support, and a complete tour booking solution, check out the Tour Engine Theme.

External services

This plugin loads a booking widget script from TicketingHub, which is required to display live booking availability and let customers complete bookings on your site.

It loads the script https://widget.ticketinghub.com/embedding/latest.js on every page where the booking widget is displayed. Depending on how the widget is configured and used, this may send booking-related data (such as selected dates, tour/activity choices, and customer booking details) to TicketingHub’s servers to process the booking.

This service is provided by TicketingHub: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Ticketing Hub in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Place the shortcode on any page or post
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Widget ID?

Log in to your TicketingHub account, go to your product or event, and copy the Widget ID from the embed settings.

Does this work with any theme?

Yes, the plugin works with any WordPress theme.

Is this an official TicketingHub plugin?

No. This is an independent integration developed by Reimagine Media. We use TicketingHub on our own websites and built this plugin to make integration easier for everyone.
